breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect statement that principal directions remain aligned with the original axes and that principal stresses are simply σx and 0. Instead, it correctly instructs to compute principal stresses σ1 and σ2 from the full plane stress state (σx, σy, τxy), which matches the ground truth intent.
